tools.Name: AI Job Search
tools.Description: An AI-powered job application framework built on Claude Code that manages the entire job hunt process, from scraping job boards to tailoring CVs and cover letters, and preparing for interviews.
tools.Use_Case: Automating job searches, CV customization, cover letter writing, and interview preparation.

tools.Name: TradingAgents
tools.Description: A multi-agent framework designed for financial trading analysis that leverages LLM-powered specialized agents (Analyst, Researcher, Trader, Risk Manager) to evaluate market conditions and simulate trading strategies.
tools.Use_Case: Collaborative market analysis and research-based trading simulation.

tools.Name: Claude Obsidian
tools.Description: A self-organizing AI second brain for Obsidian that enables users to capture source material, link and connect knowledge, and query their vault using grounded, source-cited information.
tools.Use_Case: Automated personal knowledge management and research retrieval using local Markdown files.
